patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Smartsheet and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Trello's shape. Choose Trello only if your buying job matches “Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Workflow advantage: Smartsheet leans work-management, resource-planning; Trello leans team-collaboration-work. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Smartsheet and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual.; Trello is Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Trello (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Smartsheet-leaning work-management, resource-planning, timeline-reporting vs Trello-leaning team-collaboration-work.
- Researched limits: Smartsheet — No free plan; Trello — Limited planning depth vs Work OS.

Limitations — Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump; Trello: Limited planning depth vs Work OS; Premium needed for richer views.

Poor-fit cases: Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Trello is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Limited planning depth vs Work OS · Avoid Smartsheet if you actually need Trello's motion (Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
